kingdoms.title: Vietnam: Every Year (1471 – 1862)
kingdoms.sentence: Dai Viet starts small in the north, swallows Champa province by province, and takes the Mekong delta from Cambodia by 1862.

kingdoms.title: Cambodia: Every Year (802 – 1431)
kingdoms.sentence: Khmer rule spreads from Angkor over most of mainland Southeast Asia, then shrinks back to Cambodia by the 1400s.

kingdoms.title: Indonesia: Every Year (1293 – 1527)
kingdoms.sentence: Majapahit holds Java and claims tribute across the archipelago, then breaks apart into rival sultanates by 1527.

kingdoms.title: Thailand: Every Year (1351 – 1909)
kingdoms.sentence: Siam expands over Laos and Cambodia, then treaties with Britain and France carve those lands away by 1909.

kingdoms.title: Brunei: Every Year (1400 – 1888)
kingdoms.sentence: Brunei holds much of Borneo's coast, then loses Sarawak and Sabah piece by piece to British adventurers by 1888.
